messages:
emma: Hey folks — we're hosting a Maintainer Onboarding office hours next Wed 9:00am PT for new and returning repo maintainers. Agenda: checklist walkthrough, release process pairing, and triage norms. RSVP + poll: https://tiny.redwood/maintainer-oh

raj: Can we get that recorded? I might be traveling but want the walkthrough.

emma: Yep — we'll record and drop notes into the Maintainers handbook repo after. I'll also post a short changelog for anything we update.

linh: 9am PT is rough for folks in APAC. Is there a second slot or will there be an alternate recording time?

emma: Good call. Added a quick poll in the RSVP link for alternate slots — if more APAC folks prefer a later time we'll schedule a repeat session.

mateo: Can we add a segment on "how to get write access" and the release checklist? I can demo the release script.

emma: Absolutely — adding a 20m demo of the release script. Thanks @mateo.

ashley: I'll bring the onboarding PR template and the CONTRIBUTING checklist updates I mentioned last week.

ops-bot: calendar invite created: Maintainer Office Hours — Wed 09:00 PT — https://calendar.redwood/evt/8234 (organizer: emma)

riley: Quick agenda snippet:
```
- 09:00 Intro & goals (5m)
- 09:05 Onboarding checklist walkthrough (15m)
- 09:20 Release script demo + Q&A (20m)
- 09:40 PR triage patterns & automation (15m)
- 09:55 Next steps & notes (5m)
```

emma: Thanks all — please RSVP and drop any burning questions in this thread. We'll capture action items and update the handbook repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/maintainers/handbook

raj: Thanks — I'll forward to one external contributor who wants to join.

linh: If repeat session happens, please ping #eng-asia. Appreciate the poll!

emma: Will do. Recording + notes will be posted under the handbook repo and linked in #announcements after the session. :thumbsup:
